//: Declarations only. Vite compiles the JavaScript; tsc's job here is the .d.ts
files, because a typed component library whose types are inferred by the
consumer's compiler is a library whose types change when they upgrade theirs.
Stories, tests and docs are excluded: they are how the components are checked,
not part of what ships. src/tokens is excluded for the same reason — the token
gallery is a Storybook page, and the tokens themselves ship as CSS.
